items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: Bitcoin Retakes $80,000 After Waller Signals A Hold
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he would be inclined to support leaving rates unchanged this month if the next two weeks of data hold, and Polymarket traders went from pricing a September increase at 59% on Wednesday to 43%.

items.title: Sony Dismisses PS5 Buyers' $508M Tariff Refund Claim as 'Illogical'
items.summary: The company raised PlayStation prices for a second time in March, five weeks after the tariffs were struck down.
